svg.text: how many distinct K/V heads do the 8 query heads have to share?
every query head owns its own
K/V pair - most of the quality,
one K/V pair for all eight
repeat_kv does not allocate: it expands a stride-0 view, and only the reshape() materialises it. The win is not
in the matmul - the 8 query heads still each run their own attention - it is in the cache. Decoding is memory-
bandwidth bound, so shrinking the bytes you must stream per step is the biggest single lever on tokens/second.
